newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures rise on short-covering.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures rise on short-covering.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended slightly higher on Wednesday on private investors' short-covering, supported by the yen's weakness against the dollar, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.1 yen to 1.9 yen per kg firmer. Benchmark March was up 1.1 yen at 136.0 yen.
Views that downside risk will be limited in the near term also stimulated technical-driven short-covering, but market players were still wary of taking fresh buying.
"Further gains could be capped by profit-taking unless there are fresh supportive factors," one trader said.
